```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Degrowth is necessary to stop and reverse the planetary ecological crises that capitalism and its intrinsic dependency on endless growth have caused.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism is a political and economic world-system that derives value from the exploitation of labor and natural resources.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The dynamic of exploitation within capitalism—the profit motive—drives endless accumulation of capital wealth by externalizing its social and ecological costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Externalizing social and ecological costs results in a planetary ecological crisis, of which climate change is a part.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Several major trends constitute the planetary ecological crisis: the sixth mass extinction and biodiversity loss, reversible and irreversible destruction of life-support ecosystems, plastic and toxin accumulation in all biomass and organisms, habitat destruction due to mining and industrial agriculture, and dispossession of Indigenous land protectors from their sovereign territories.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Biophysical, planetary limits to economic growth exist (Steffen et al., 2015).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Taking ecological pressure off humanity’s life-support ecosystems is a central goal of degrowth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Caracol DSA affirms the need for an improved and expanded Green New Deal—without growth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Ecosocialist degrowth is more than a change of property forms; it is a civilizational transformation and a new way of life based on values of solidarity, democracy, equaliberty, and respect for Earth.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ecosocialist degrowth can only win through a confrontation with the fossil oligarchy and the ruling classes who control political and economic power.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
